digest.component_or_area: scripts/gen_env_registry.py env-var scanner and docs/env-vars.md generation
propositions: The scanner recognizes only os.environ.get, os.environ[...] subscript, and os.getenv forms; any other attribute access method (pop, setdefault, etc.) is silently skipped and its variable omitted from the registry
A refactor from os.environ.get to os.environ.pop silently drops the variable from docs/env-vars.md with no error signal or exit-code change
The CI drift gate catches registry staleness only in the full test suite, not in local make lint, creating asymmetric feedback between local and CI verification

The fix must classify all os.environ attribute accesses (get, pop, setdefault, __getitem__ as key-bearing; copy, items, keys, etc. as bulk), and raise UnrecognisedEnvironAccess for any unrecognized form to fail the build
Local make lint must run gen_env_registry --check to detect staleness before CI, closing the local/CI signal gap

Existing pop-based reads in the codebase (opcert_service/config.py, _io/import_ndjson.py) are currently mitigated by sibling .get reads but represent latent defects that will surface on future refactors
